title: NotAIry
tagline: NotAIry is a decentralized platform that combines AI-powered analysis with Web3 identity to create trusted, verified stories about blockchain technology and AI developments.
description: NotAIry is a decentralized platform that combines AI-powered analysis with Web3 identity to create trusted, verified stories about blockchain technology and AI developments. The platform helps writers create high-quality technical content while providing readers with confidence in the accuracy and authenticity of the information.
how_its_made:
Key Features
Smart Contract Integration
MetaMask wallet integration for Web3 identity
On-chain identity scoring using transaction history and DeFi activity
Wallet-based authentication and authorization
AI-Powered Content Analysis
Automated story review and scoring system
Technical accuracy validation
Content quality assessment
Engagement potential analysis
Story Management
Multi-status workflow (draft, in review, published)
Real-time story updates and notifications
Rich text editing and formatting
Story categorization (smart contracts, AI models, DeFi protocols)
Identity & Trust
Web3 identity verification
Trust scoring based on on-chain activity
DeFi participation metrics
NFT holdings analysis
Social engagement tracking
Technical Stack
Frontend: SvelteKit
Backend: Supabase
Blockchain: Base (Coinbase L2)
AI: Gaia AI for content analysis
Data: Covalent API for on-chain analytics
Privy.io for authentication
Core Mission
NotAIry aims to bridge the gap between technical content creation and verification in the Web3 space. By leveraging AI for initial content validation and combining it with Web3 identity, we create a trusted environment for sharing and verifying blockchain and AI-related stories.

The platform helps ensure that technical content about smart contracts, AI models, and DeFi protocols is accurate, well-written, and properly contextualized, while maintaining the decentralized ethos of Web3.
